finding: In Taiwanese singleton pregnancies, prepregnancy overweight and obesity were associated with higher rates of cesarean section, hypertensive disorders, preeclampsia, and preterm birth.
mod_finding: The study found that prepregnancy overweight and obese women had higher rates of cesarean section, hypertensive disorder, preeclampsia, preeclampsia with severe features, and preterm birth compared to normal-weight women.
